name: arabic-church-assistant
description: Listens to an Arabic sermon and brings up Bible verses and hymn videos as they are mentioned. Desktop app for Windows and Mac.
author: Sameh Welson Faragallah

scripts.test: node test/engine.test.js && node test/youtube.test.js && node test/detect.test.js && node test/director.test.js && node test/english.test.js
scripts.test:engine: if exist engine\python\python.exe (engine\python\python.exe test\engine_faults.py) else (engine\.venv\Scripts\python.exe test\engine_faults.py)
